Date: 2021-03-12
REMARKS
Applicant respectfully requests that the foregoing amendments be made prior to examination of the present application.
By this preliminary amendment, claims 1-21 have been amended. Claim 12 has been cancelled, its subject matter having been incorporated into claim 2; and no new claims have been added. Claims 1-11 and 13-21 are thus currently pending in this application, with claim 1 being the only independent claim. No new matter is added.
None of the claims now pending are multiple dependent claims. Further, the number of claims now pending do not incur "excess" fees.
The abstract has also been amended as provided herewith to remove the language "comprising" and "comprises" as well as the reference numerals therefrom. No new matter is added by these amendments.
Favorable consideration of the application as amended is respectfully requested. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned to advance the prosecution of the present
application.
Respectfully submitted,
